summary.headline: Signs of Royal Nativities
summary.text: Astrological judgments for royal nativities: the Sun or Moon in exaltation, angular luminaries, royal signs, applying rulers, Jupiter, and other planets in the oriental midheaven are said to signify kingship, royal dignity, power, and control of public affairs.
